title: Day after being slapped at Jaipur rally, Cockroach Janta Party's Abhijeet Dipke says, ‘If he had a job…’
description: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke was slapped at a Jaipur protest over NEET paper leaks and unemployment. He later blamed rising joblessness for the attack and announced a march to Delhi on 20 June, demanding Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation.
